title: docs(gates): delete the spec-docblock gate's stale "symbol is ZERO" reason
body:
Fixes #17242
Clause-②: no

Round 6: one file, `scripts/check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors.mjs`, comments only.

## What was stale

The header section headed "`counts.symbol` is ZERO on this corpus", the case-4 note and one sentence of the case-5 note said the spec tree holds exactly one symbol-anchor-shaped span and that it does not resolve. They gave that as the reason the live-corpus self-test does not assert `symbol > 0`.

## Re-derived

Instrument: this gate's `CORPUS` and `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs` at `4b23e4fab5`, swept over a checkout of each tree.

| tree | anchors | symbol (declaration) | declined | symbol-anchor-shaped spans | the `websocket.zod.ts` span |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `08e38c6377` (census) | 2639 | 0 (0) | 183 | 1 | present, unresolved |
| `fa29803417` (re-census) | 3437 | 6 (6) | 467 | 7 | present, unresolved |
| `4b23e4fab5` (base) | 3448 | 6 (6) | 502 | 7 | present, unresolved, pinned |

Controls: each older tree's own instrument gives the same counts. The gate at `fa29803417` prints 3437 / 6 (6) / 467. `08e38c6377` has no gate, so its own `symbol-anchors.mjs` was run with the same corpus spec and read 0 / 2639 / 183. The six resolving spans are 2 in `data/analytics.zod.ts`, 3 in `kernel/functional-completeness.ts` and 1 in `ui/action-params.zod.ts`.

⇒ The text was true at the census tree and false at `fa29803417` and at base.

## Change: deleted only

- The header section, from its heading to its last paragraph. The `websocket.zod.ts` part was still true, and its `CENSUS_RESIDUAL` row still carries the doc, the citation and the repair.
- The case-4 note.
- The case-5 sentence that called that loop the positive control for "the ONE symbol-shaped span".

No reason replaces them. Claim audit: 0 sentences added or changed in the file. The self-test still asserts `fileLevel` and does not assert `symbol > 0`. The ratchet recommendation recorded by #19733 is unchanged and not restated here.

## Verification, at `d23edb4eef`

- Gate, `--list-unresolvable` and `--self-test`: exit 0 at base and head, stdout byte-identical (`cmp` 0; sha256 `44a6a984…`, `af5d0039…`, `1dcc0b91…`), stderr empty.
- Comment-only: the TypeScript printer's output with comments removed is identical at base and head (sha256 `8865ec39…`). Lit control: a one-character code mutation makes it differ. The self-test floor stays 124.
- `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` (sweeps this file): exit 0. Anchors 3694 → 3691 and file-level 3642 → 3639; symbol 52 and declined 14 unchanged. The −3 are the three code spans in the deleted text. Its self-test exits 0.
- `dispatch-gates`: 31 derived, 31 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reads 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Outside that total: the 2 workflow-valued families and the Test Core steps run in CI only. The 14 changeset-pending families do not apply (no changeset: a repo-root script in the private root package).
- ESLint on the file: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Repo-wide lint is left to CI.
- 0 control bytes and 0 model identifiers in the file and the commit message. Lit control: a planted control byte and a planted model identifier are both found.

## Acceptance notes

- No `symbol > 0` live control is proposed. Case 1 already asserts `declaration >= 1` and `literal >= 1` through the same `CORPUS` on its fixture. A live floor would add a constraint on authors and no new detection. Noted, not filed; carrier: none.
